title: Variable Pursuits @ The Maryland Zoo
shortDescription: Arduino based node network improving animal welfare.
description: As an Engineering Intern, I enhanced animal well-being by developing interactive enrichment devices that integrate Arduino microcontrollers with sound, motion detection, and RF communication modules. To improve usability, I created a C++ user interface that streamlined system control for zookeepers. Through extensive testing and validation of LiDAR, PIR, and Doppler sensors, I achieved a 95% detection accuracy rate. This project has also led to partnerships with leading zoos across the country, with active plans to implement the enrichment devices in facilities spanning over five states.
